```artifact
Feature: User Experience and Performance

  Scenario: People with no computer background can use the system relatively easily
    Given the user has no prior experience with computers
    When they navigate to the system homepage
    Then the system displays a clear and simple interface

  Scenario: System navigation is simple and intuitive
    Given the user is on the system homepage
    When they click on the "Consultation Request" tab
    Then the system displays the consultation request form with clear labels and instructions

  Scenario: Installation Guide is prepared
    Given the user is on the system homepage
    When they click on the "Installation Guide" link
    Then the system displays the installation guide with clear instructions

  Scenario: User Manual for end users is prepared
    Given the user is on the system homepage
    When they click on the "User Manual" link
    Then the system displays the user manual with clear instructions

  Scenario: Normal Consultation Request is filled in less than 5 minutes
    Given the user is on the consultation request form
    When they fill in the form with minimal and only relevant questions
    Then the system submits the form in less than 5 minutes

  Scenario: Boundary - Consultation Request is filled in exactly 5 minutes
    Given the user is on the consultation request form
    When they fill in the form with minimal and only relevant questions, taking exactly 5 minutes
    Then the system submits the form in exactly 5 minutes

  Scenario: Error - Invalid input
    Given the user is on the consultation request form
    When they enter invalid input
    Then the system displays an error message indicating invalid input

  Scenario: Error - Missing field
    Given the user is on the consultation request form
    When they omit a required field
    Then the system displays an error message indicating a missing field

  Scenario: Error - Invalid format
    Given the user is on the consultation request form
    When they enter input in an invalid format
    Then the system displays an error message indicating an invalid format
```
